title: SunEdison Sets Bankruptcy Exit With Nothing for Shareholders
主要内容: SunEdison Inc. received final approval for a bankruptcy plan that will leave it as a shell of its former self, with nothing for shareholders whose investment had been worth about $10 billion. The company, known for rapid expansion, will exit Chapter 11 to continue business operations and maximize the value of its remaining assets, including intellectual property and fixtures, according to CFO Philip Gund.
